CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of The Inspired Word of God? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Inspired Word of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say The Inspired Word of God has no place in daily life.
   C. Use The Inspired Word of God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Inspired Word of God.

   D. Use The Annunciation to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Patriarchs Abraham.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
